# Filter the row for "Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps"
row = df[df['Description Losses'] == 'Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps']

# Extract the year columns (excluding 'Total') and find the column with the maximum value
year_columns = ['1939/40', '1940/41', '1941/42', '1942/43', '1943/44', '1944/45']
# Get the values for these columns as a Series
values = row[year_columns].iloc[0]

# Find the year(s) with the maximum value
max_value = values.max()
max_years = values[values == max_value].index.tolist()

# The question asks for "during what year", implying a singular answer.
# If there are multiple years with the same max, we take the first one as per typical interpretation.
answer = max_years[0] if max_years else None
